title: Currency swaps, loss quantiles, and tail risk
objectives: Reconcile domestic-valued currency legs and forward-converted cash-flow valuation with explicit units
Construct and index synchronized historical loss scenarios
Derive Gaussian VaR with drift and horizon qualifications
Compute expected shortfall with probability atoms and exhibit VaR aggregation failure

source_scope: Full official English captions at positions58–59 read sequentially. No comprehensive audiovisual audit. Source principal mismatch, pricing-versus-risk probabilities, lower empirical quantile indexing, nonmaximum VaR interpretation, and square-root scaling limits are explicit. ES and discrete counterexamples are added enrichment.
